name: PUMA
def: Six axis industrial robot arm that Victor Scheinman developed at Unimation, first for General Motors, from designs he had begun at Stanford University.
facts: Initially developed by Unimation for General Motors
Based on earlier designs Scheinman created at Stanford University
Name stands for Programmable Universal Machine for Assembly
